definitions.gloss: enlightenment; educating the public; raising awareness
definitions.explanation: Spreading knowledge or correct understanding among people who lack it, through campaigns, books or teaching.

examples.japanese: {啓蒙|けいもう}{活動|かつどう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧さ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{市民|しみん}→市民：01426_shimin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{啓蒙|けいもう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To teach citizens the importance of health.

examples.japanese: {十八世紀|じゅうはっせいき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ヨーロッパ→ヨーロッパ：00427_yooroppa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{理性|りせい}→理性：17951_risei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{重|おも}んじる→重んじる：14445_omonjiru⟧{啓蒙|けいもう}⟦{思想|しそう}→思想：03173_shisou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}まり→広まる：02404_hiromaru⟧、⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}えた→与える：01821_ataeru⟧。
examples.english: In eighteenth-century Europe, Enlightenment thought, which prized reason, spread widely and had a great effect on society.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {啓蒙|けいもう}{活動|かつどう}: awareness campaign, public education
- {啓蒙|けいもう}⟦{思想|しそう}→思想：03173_shisou⟧: Enlightenment thought
- {啓蒙|けいもう}⟦{書|しょ}→〜書：28467_sho⟧: a book written to educate the general reader

WATCH OUT:
{蒙|もう} means ignorance, so {啓蒙|けいもう} can sound condescending, as if the audience were ignorant. Public bodies now usually say ⟦{啓発|けいはつ}→啓発：32267_keihatsu⟧ for awareness campaigns (⟦{人権|じんけん}→人権：05416_jinken⟧⟦{啓発|けいはつ}→啓発：32267_keihatsu⟧). {啓蒙|けいもう} stays standard for the historical Enlightenment.
